totemtweaks.settings.title: Totem Tweaks
totemtweaks.settings.totem_size.descript: The size of a totem held in either hand.
totemtweaks.settings.pop_size.descriptio: The size of the totem that appears on screen when a totem pops. 1.0 is the vanilla size.
totemtweaks.settings.disable_equip_anima: Shows a totem at full height as soon as it is in your hand, so you see it is there sooner.
totemtweaks.settings.pop_animation.descr: Shows the totem on screen when a totem pops.
totemtweaks.settings.animation_speed.des: How long the pop animation lasts, in ticks. Vanilla lasts 40 ticks.
totemtweaks.settings.lock_rotation_posit: Keeps the popped totem in the center of the screen instead of drifting to a random side.
totemtweaks.settings.disable_rotations.d: Stops the popped totem from spinning and tilting.
totemtweaks.settings.static_size.descrip: Keeps the popped totem at its largest size for the whole animation instead of growing and shrinking.
totemtweaks.settings.enable_totem_size_c: Makes a held totem grow and shrink between the minimum and maximum size. Replaces Totem Size while on.
totemtweaks.settings.totem_size_change_s: How fast a held totem grows and shrinks.
totemtweaks.settings.min_totem_size.desc: The smallest size a held totem shrinks to.
totemtweaks.settings.max_totem_size.desc: The largest size a held totem grows to.
